title: Queues, jobs, retries, backoff, failed jobs, Horizon

preview.what: Queues: jobs, retries, backoff, failed jobs, Horizon, and what can go wrong.
preview.picture: A restaurant ticket rail: the waiter (web request) posts the ticket and moves on; cooks (workers) pick tickets up. Some dishes fail and need re-cooking — but not forever.
preview.why: Queues are where most 'tell me about a production incident' stories live.
preview.bn: Restaurant-এর টিকিট রেল: waiter টিকিট দিয়ে চলে যায়, cook তোলে; ব্যর্থ হলে আবার, কিন্তু চিরকাল না।
